- run through total comp and signposting in the offer PDF

Marissa / Laura — I reviewed the attached v1. Two short requests:
1) Replace the ambiguous phrase in section 5 ("post-termination PTO payout") with our standard clause: "Accrued but unused PTO will be paid in accordance with applicable law and Redwood payroll policy." This avoids state-by-state carveouts in the offer PDF.
2) Add a one-sentence conditioning statement in section 2 about background check completion prior to start (standard).

I do not think either change affects comp. If Rebecca needs a redlined PDF, I can produce v2 today — let me know and I’ll attach. Also confirm whether Kyle is on H-1B previously or fully US citizen — if visa, we must tweak payroll wording.

—Markus
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Per Markus’s email, attached is v2 with the legal tweaks and the DocuSign envelope link for your review. We will not send the envelope until after the call unless you confirm now.

From: Kyle Mendoza <kyle.mendoza@gmail.com>
To: Rebecca Lin <rebecca@talentbright.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confirmed — Thu 6/12 10:30 PT + envelope link

Quick follow-up after the call — thanks everyone for the clear walkthrough. A couple of items I wanted to confirm before signing:
1) Start date flexibility: I’d like to propose Jul 28 as my earliest effective date instead of the Jul 7–21 window because I have a final contractor commitment through Jul 25. Is that acceptable?
2) PTO payout wording: I appreciate the standard clause but would like confirmation that accrued PTO from my contractor engagement will be handled by my previous employer (they confirmed separately). The offer’s PTO clause is fine as-is if payroll handles that.
3) Equity vesting: Could we clarify that vesting commencement is the employee start date (i.e., Jul 28 if we agree)?

If we can fold the start-date change into the envelope (or add an addendum that lists the agreed effective date), I’m happy to sign the e-sign packet promptly.

Best,
Kyle
